## Checklist

- [ ] `uv run ruff check .` and `uv run pytest` pass locally.
- [ ] Docs are updated for any change in behaviour, and every command in them still works.
- [ ] No API keys, tokens, `.env` files or credentials, not even "test" ones.
- [ ] No organisation-confidential material: internal policies, real email addresses, logos, staff names, screenshots of private tools.
- [ ] Every new image, font, sound, music file or script I added is my own work or has a licence that allows redistribution, recorded in `docs/ASSET_LICENSES.md`.
- [ ] No likeness of a real person and no cloned voice without written consent.
- [ ] Sample scenes state no invented deadlines, pass marks, legal duties or certifications.
